## FALL 2026: A C.U.R.E for Invasions
<hr>
<br/>

* **A C.U.R.E. (Course-based Undergraduate Research Experience) is a class where students do real, original scientific research or creative inquiry as part of the regular curriculum**

<br/>

* **You will need to build the skills to solve/mitigate the issues of your invasive species**

<br/>

* **Find data → Clean data → Analyze → Map → Research management → Communicate → Build an Action Plan**
    + Real tools. Real data. Real ecological problem.

<br/>

* **Each Friday (+ a little more) you will learn new applied skills to eventually mitigate your species**
    + These skills are transferable on the job market (your resume)
    + Create a portfolio of products that you can use in an internship, job, or graduate-school interview.
    
## What is ecology (textbook definition)?
<hr>
<br/>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:180px; LEFT:25px; WIDTH:450px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/earth.jpg">

<div style="float: right; width: 55%;">

* **Ecology has a few big themes:**

<br/>

* **study of the interactions between living organisms and their physical environment**
    + Includes living and non-living components

<br/>

* **(1) Distribution and abundance of organisms**

<br/>

* **(2) Interactions among organisms**

<br/> 

* **(3) Transformation and flux of energy and matter**
    
</div>

## For Journal Club this week....
<hr>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 50%;">

* **Read "100 articles every ecologist should read"**
    + article and cheat sheet on Brightspace

<br/>

* **Take specific notes**
    + What ecological themes are common?
    + Do you feel any themes are missing?
    + Is there a take home message?
    + Is there anything you don't understand?
    + *Complete and submit your reflection in person before class starts*

<br/>

* **Pay attention to little details**
    + Are there any patterns you see?
    + Do you detect any issues?
    
</div>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:180px; LEFT:580px; WIDTH:450px; HEIGHT:500px" SRC="images/100.png">

## Journal Club warning...
<hr>

* **If there is one thing that I know in life it is plants !**

<br/>

* **If there are two things that I know, the second is if you have read the paper.**
    + It is obvious to me when you are not prepared for the readings.
    + I can easily distinguish between misunderstanding and poor preparation!
    + <span style="color:red">I expect you to have a copy of the paper and notes in class (phone is not acceptable) </span>

<br/>

* **I take this very seriously and you will NOT do well in this class if you do not participate**
    + <span style="color:red">The reflection is required to participate in Journal Club. No points will be rewarded for late submission</span>
    
<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:495px; LEFT:300px; WIDTH:500px; HEIGHT:200px" SRC="images/warn.jpg">
